description: This file provides functions for reading and exposing environment configuration variables for the Talenvia frontend, specifically handling environment variables prefixed with REACT_APP_. It defines a function getEnvConfig that returns a structured object containing various environment settings, including URLs, environment modes, log levels, and feature flags.

methods.name: getEnvConfig()
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables, applies defaults, parses feature flags JSON, and returns a configuration object with environment settings for the application.
